bearerAuth.description: Required on every endpoint except /health, /api/v1/openapi.json, /api/v1/docs, and the unauthenticated /api/v1/pair/* pairing bootstrap. info.description: Queue booru URLs for download into monbooru. Errors answer {error, code}; clients branch on code.
